source.title: Applications for Worlds Championship 2021 and Continental Championships 2022
source.content:
Application submissions are now closed for World Championship 2021 and Continental Championships 2022. Thank you to all who submitted their offers! The cities listed were submitted and will be selected by the Board of Directors.

**2021 World Championship:**
Almere, Netherlands
Vladivostok, Russia

**2022 Asian Championship:**
Semey, Kazakhstan

**2022 European Championship:**
Copenhagen, Denmark

**2022 North American Championship:**
Toronto, Canada

The candidacy documents will be made public after the decisions are finalized.

translation.title: 2021 年世界锦标赛及 2022 年洲际锦标赛申办情况
translation.content:
2021 年世界锦标赛及 2022 年洲际锦标赛的申办现已截止。感谢所有提交方案的团队！以下城市已提交申请，董事会将从中选定举办地。

**2021 年世界锦标赛：**

- 荷兰阿尔梅勒
- 俄罗斯符拉迪沃斯托克

**2022 年亚洲锦标赛：**

- 哈萨克斯坦塞梅伊

**2022 年欧洲锦标赛：**

- 丹麦哥本哈根

**2022 年北美锦标赛：**

- 加拿大多伦多

决定确定后，将公布申办材料。
